text:
Amina Rahman: Quick ask - hiring manager wants a one-time band uplift for Samir Patel (Backend Eng) to beat a counteroffer. Request: provisional M3 -> M4 + $6k sign-on. Candidate will accept if we confirm by EOD. Payroll cutoff Weds.
Carlos Vega: Can you drop the manager justification and proposed start date? Also need cost center.
Amina Rahman: Manager justification uploaded to the candidate packet: seniority, market comp, counteroffer details. Proposed start 2026-04-10 (default 2026-04-24). Cost center ENG-BE. Invoice code pending.
Priya Kapoor: Routing now to comp committee & Legal. hr-ops-bot will track. Setting 48h decision window since candidate is time-sensitive. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
hr-ops-bot: Request 3609876543 created. Approvals required: Comp Committee, Legal Team, Payroll Ops. Deadline: 48h.
Payroll Ops: Manual payroll possible if we receive invoice code and Workday entries before payroll lock. Confirm exact start date and final compensation fields.
Carlos Vega: Legal will need a standard clawback for sign-on > $5k. Tagging Legal.
Legal Team: Noted. We can approve with a 50%/full clawback schedule (within 6 months/3 months). Drafting clause now.
Comp Committee: Can we get manager note on why provisional rather than higher band permanent? Need market comps.
Amina Rahman: Manager note: short-term market mismatch, provisional uplift to align offer and evaluate after 90 days. Uploaded market comps and manager sign-off.
Comp Committee: Approved provisional M4 for 90 days and $6k sign-on pending Legal clawback language. Voting: unanimous.
Legal Team: Clawback clause drafted and approved. No red flags.
hr-ops-bot: Approval update: Comp Committee=approved, Legal Team=approved, Payroll Ops=pending (awaiting invoice code).
Amina Rahman: Manager DMed invoice code INV-4521. Priya, can you proceed to send the updated offer letter with provisional band M4, $6k sign-on, clawback clause, start 2026-04-10? Candidate acceptance window 48h.
Priya Kapoor: Will send now and CC payroll ops for Workday entries. If candidate signs before payroll cutoff we can do manual setup; otherwise start will be 2026-04-24.
Amina Rahman: Thanks team. Will update this thread when offer is signed. :pray:
